title: Do Hierarchical Networks Actually Learn? Insights from Word-of-Mouth Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2611.20806v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study recursive estimation of a constant state vector by a hierarchical network of asymmetrically informed linear estimators, modeled as a directed tree. Only the leaves observe the regression signal, whereas every other estimator learns by word of mouth from noisy signal estimates relayed by its children. Authority within the hierarchy is expressed through common prior information: after each round, every estimator adopts the estimate and error covariance broadcast by the root. The more accurate this common information, the larger the effective noise variance on local observations, which makes estimation intrinsically self-defeating. The resulting performance is the subject of this paper. We show that recursive least-squares (RLS) estimators do learn the state in mean square, albeit slowly. translated_title: 分层网络真的在学习吗？来自口碑估计的洞察
translated_abstract: 我们研究了由信息不对称的线性估计器组成的分层网络对恒定状态向量的递归估计问题，该网络被建模为一棵有向树。只有叶子节点能够观测到回归信号，而其余每个估计器都通过“口碑”方式学习——即从其子节点转发的含噪信号估计中获取信息。层级体系中的权威性通过共同先验信息来表达：在每一轮之后，每个估计器都采纳由根节点广播的估计值和误差协方差。这种共同信息越准确，局部观测上的有效噪声方差就越大，这使得估计过程本质上具有自我挫败的特性。由此产生的性能正是本文的研究主题。我们证明了递归最小二乘（RLS）估计器确实能够在均方意义下学习到该状态，尽管速度较慢。在强持续激励条件下，广播的误差协方差随时间呈多项式衰减，我们通过上下界刻画了该衰减速率。
tldr: 本文证明，在以共同先验信息实现权威、本质上“自我挫败”的分层口碑估计网络中，递归最小二乘估计器仍能在均方意义下（尽管缓慢地）学到真实状态，且广播误差协方差在强持续激励下随时间多项式衰减。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that in hierarchical word-of-mouth estimation networks—where authority via common prior information makes estimation intrinsically self-defeating—recursive least-squares estimators still learn the true state in mean square, albeit slowly, with the broadcast error covariance decaying polynomially under strong persistency of excitation.
